beschreibung:
Baroque Townhouse and Cultural Monument

In the heart of the market town of Reutte stands the Museum Grünes Haus, one of the most beautiful historic townhouses in the Außerfern. Dating back to the 16th century, this heritage-listed building captivates with its distinctive green facade, which was decorated in the 18th century with masterful illusionist painting.

Significant Art Collection and Local History

Awarded the Tiroler Museumspreis multiple times, the museum presents outstanding works by the Zeiller family of painters, significant testimonies of sacred art, and historical exhibits showcasing the development of Reutte as an important trading hub along the Fernpass trade routes.
